mapper.select: SELECT INSURER_CD, POLICY_NO, KIND_CD, START_DATE, END_DATE, COVERED_YN, NON_COVERED_YN FROM TB_SIM_KCIS_CONTRACT WHERE INSURED_ID = #{insuredId} AND START_DATE <= #{baseDate} AND END_DATE > #{baseDate} ORDER BY INSURER_CD, POLICY_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SIM_KCIS_CONTRACT (INSURED_ID, INSURER_CD, POLICY_NO, KIND_CD, START_DATE, END_DATE, COVERED_YN, NON_COVERED_YN) VALUES (#{insuredId}, #{c.insurerCd}, #{c.policyNo}, #{c.kindCd}, #{c.startDate}, #{c.endDate}, #{c.coveredYn}, #{c.nonCoveredYn}) ON CONFLICT (INSURER_CD, POLICY_NO) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SIM_KCIS_CONTRACT SET END_DATE = #{endDate} WHERE INSURER_CD = #{insurerCd} AND POLICY_NO = #{policyNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SIM_KCIS_RECEIPT (TX_TYPE, TRACE_NO, MESSAGE, RECEIVED_DT) VALUES (#{txType}, #{traceNo}, #{message}, #{receivedDt})
mapper.select: SELECT HOLDER_NM, STAT_CD, BALANCE FROM TB_SIM_BANK_ACCOUNT WHERE BANK_CD = #{bankCd} AND ACCOUNT_NO = #{accountNo}
mapper.sql: TRACE_NO, BANK_CD, ACCOUNT_NO, AMOUNT, RECIPIENT_NM, PROC_DT
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SIM_BANK_ACCOUNT SET BALANCE = BALANCE - #{amount} WHERE BANK_CD = #{bankCd} AND ACCOUNT_NO = #{accountNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SIM_CMS_MANDATE (ORG_CODE, PAYER_NO, BANK_CD, ACCOUNT_NO, REG_DT) VALUES (#{orgCode}, #{payerNo}, #{bankCd}, #{accountNo}, #{regDt}) ON CONFLICT (ORG_CODE, PAYER_NO) DO UPDATE SET BANK_CD = EXCLUDED.BANK_CD, ACCOUNT_NO = EXCLUDED.ACCOUNT_NO, REG_DT = EXCLUDED.REG_DT
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SIM_CMS_MANDATE WHERE ORG_CODE = #{orgCode} AND PAYER_NO = #{payerNo} AND BANK_CD = #{bankCd} AND ACCOUNT_NO = #{accountNo})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SIM_CMS_FILE (FILE_TYPE, FILE_DT, CONTENT, CREATED_DT) VALUES (#{fileType}, #{fileDt}, #{content}, #{createdDt}) ON CONFLICT (FILE_TYPE, FILE_DT) DO UPDATE SET CONTENT = EXCLUDED.CONTENT, CREATED_DT = EXCLUDED.CREATED_DT
mapper.select: SELECT CONTENT FROM TB_SIM_CMS_FILE WHERE FILE_TYPE = #{fileType} AND FILE_DT = #{fileDt}
